notes.title: Daily Challenges & New Hats!
notes.content:
Are y’all turnips ready to compete?

Today we’re introducing Daily Challenge Contests in our latest patch, v1.1.2! Daily 
Challenge Contests are a Steam-exclusive, limited-time contest where you can compete to get
the farthest in the Daily Challenge for real prizes! We’re planning on hosting several of these, 
and our Discord is the best place to find out when we’re hosting them!

To celebrate the start of these contests, the winner of the first challenge will win a Turnip Boy 
plush!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36538885/a2d8d9238fe64263e5c0d70d5ea0d92445d5f418.jpg[/img]

Additionally, we’ve released a new Tax Hat just in time for Tax Day! Avoid paying your taxes in 
style with this haute couture.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36538885/7a7ba6a1b2802e2980fc345f8d2d22202228bb93.gif[/img]

You can access the Tax Hat from the mailbox outside of Turnip Boy's greenhouse once you 
update the game. What’s more, it’s not the only hat you’ll receive this year. :) We have timed hat
releases in the next year to coincide with major holidays. Follow us on Discord or Twitter to 
learn when they release. 

And now for bug fixes, improvements to features, and general quality of life improvements.

[h3]Gameplay changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Introduced limited-time Daily Challenge Contests! You’ll also be able to see if a Daily Challenge Contest is active by looking at the leaderboards in Sunset Station! (Steam only! Internet connection required!)
[*] Added Japanese localization!
[*] Riot shield now blocks poison!
[*] Added an option to turn off movement camera panning.
[*] Add deadzones on both the right and left sticks on controllers. (This should help combat slight Joycon drift for everyone playing on the Nintendo Switch!)
[*] Slightly moved Tots over to the left to prevent soft-locking.
[*] The “retry” text when dying now says “continue” on the Limitless Line to help communicate that when you die, it returns you to Sunset Station, and doesn’t instantly start a new run.
[*] Added a sub shop sign near the Waysandwich sandwich shop.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Daily Challenges have been completely overhauled, and now reset at midnight EST worldwide. (Steam only! Internet connection required!)
[*] Plastic fangs should no longer revive and softlock the player if you kill an enemy while dying.
[*] Optimized downloading leaderboards on Steam to combat longer loading screens. (Steam only!)
[*] Fixed the “Unsupported Platform” message appearing on the Nintendo Switch, regardless of if they have obtained a Daily Ticket.
[*] Removed the introduction videos and replaced them with static logos to provide better support for Linux & the Steam Deck.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would display “1” instead of “100%” when speedrunning.
[*] Moved some trees to prevent the player from going past the load zone in the area of the Weapon Woods with the road.
[/list]

We hope to see y’all on the leaderboards!

notes.title: Turnip Boy Commits Tax Evasion restored full Linux support in the latest update
notes.content:
Recently it was announced by developer Snoozy Kazoo that their (rather great) game Turnip Boy Commits Tax Evasion was ending Linux support but they've now restored it.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/09/turnip-boy-commits-tax-evasion-restored-full-linux-support-in-the-latest-update

notes.title: Turnip Boy Commits Tax Evasion Update v1.1.0f2!
notes.content:
Today we're launching v1.1.0f2 of [b]Turnip Boy Commits Tax Evasion[/b]!

This update mainly focuses on smaller bug fixes surrounding the Sunset Station Update! While this doesn't address everything we're planning on fixing, this update is our first step to polish up the experience!

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reduced the Daily Challenge Ticket cost to 5 Blue Tickets.
[*]Decreased the rate which sheep shoot out wool by half a second.
[*]Increased the Explosive Keg's chance of causing an enemy explosion from 20% to 45%.
[*]Doubled the amount of damage the Sawblade does to enemies, and increased it's knockback by 50%.
[*]Slightly edited the Daily Challenge Leaderboard's position & filled the gap it left with bushes.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an exploit where players could farm enemies spawned by bosses to increase their daily score.
[*]Conductor Onion will put himself out from being on fire when teleporting.
[/list]

We hope this update helps resolve some common issues, and we hope your turnip experience is [b]fun as heck[/b]! :)

notes.title: Turnip Boy Commits Tax Evasion's free update adds an endless mode
notes.content:
I need a new name for games like Turnip Boy Commits Tax Evasion. It's a 2D Zelda-ish game with dungeons, melee combat, and a little light puzzling, but more specifically it's a todo list game. A pleasant set of not-to-difficult tasks to perform, with a constant drip of accomplishment and rewards. I found it very moreish to play through, ticking off just-one-more fetch question and dungeon run until I ran out of game.

Anyway, its new free Sunset Station update makes it endless. Oh no.

Read more

notes.title: The Sunset Station Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today we're launching v1.1.0 of [b]Turnip Boy Commits Tax Evasion[/b], an update we're dubbing [b]The Sunset Station Update[/b]!

This is an absolutely massive update that took several months for us to develop! We've added an infinite train dungeon to the game known as the [b]Limitless Line[/b]!

The [b]Limitless Line[/b] is not just another dungeon, as it has its own type of items called [b]Trinkets[/b], which are obtained during runs and define a meta of their own! Not only that, we've added a ton of rewards for doing well in the dungeon, the chance for familiar characters you know and love to appear on the train, and an absolute ton more! To access Sunset Station, you must first complete the game to unlock a ticket for the Limitless Line. 

Check out the trailer!

[previewyoutube=sNuVbjprzJo;full][/previewyoutube]

Here's a list of all the additions and changes!

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a [b]new boss fight[/b] in an [b]infinite train dungeon[/b]!
[*]Added [b]looping [/b]for those who are daring!
[*]Added a [b]Daily Challenge[/b]! (Steam ONLY)
[*]Added [b]3 new, never before seen enemies[/b]!
[*]Added [b]elite enemies[/b] that will mess you up!
[*]Added some of your [b]favorite characters[/b] with new dialogue to the Limitless Line (and some [b]new ones[/b])!
[*]Added the [b]Blue Tickets[/b] that are acquired by defeating bosses & a [b]shop to spend them at[/b]!
[*]Added [b]15 new hats[/b] to acquire via the ticket shop at Sunset Station!
[*]Added [b]11 trinkets[/b]!
[*]Added [b]???[/b]
[*]Made combat a ton more snappy.
[*]Adjusted hitboxes on most tools/weapons.
[*]Removed sleep frames from the entire game.
[*]You can no longer skip the credits on your first complete.
[*]There is now a button prompt for backing out of the credits.
[*]Changed Deb's first interaction to give you the key without looking at the mission board.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]The Rotten Cat Apple no longer can flip to face you when dying.
[*]Fixed the community popup not properly selecting the "okie" button.
[*]Reduced the load the hat select screen has when you first load it.
[*]Fixed an issue where hit flashing wouldn't occur.
[*]"Continue" on the main menu should properly localize when you change the language while still in the menu.
[/list]

[b]ALL ABOARDDDDDDDDDDD!!![/b]

notes.title: Update v1.0.1! (& v1.0.2!) & NEW HATS, Oh My!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today we're launching v1.0.1 (& v1.0.2) of [b]Turnip Boy Commits Tax Evasion[/b]!

While this update mainly focuses on bug fixes, improvements to features, and general quality of life improvements, [b]we've managed to sneak in a few hats[/b]! :)

Before we dive into the gameplay changes and bug fixes, let’s talk about our new hats. We have three new hats that you’ll access from the mailbox outside of Turnip Boy's greenhouse. Here’s a preview of one of them - [b]Cat ears are in[/b]! =^._.^= ∫

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36538885/a381fec7422a0bfa3417686a1c50d22687fa1815.png[/img]

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added new hats!
[*]Added Traditional Chinese & Korean localization! (v1.0.2)
[*]Implemented God% as a possible speedrun route. (This requires you to beat the secret boss in a typical Any% run.)
[*]Added a sign in the graveyard to help teach players that they can dig up graves with their Soil Sword.
[*][spoiler]Ellan's Boombloom doesn't spawn until you encounter the rest of the I.R.S. in the secret boss fight.[/spoiler]
[*]The Mission board now has an ok button to make closing it more intuitive.
[*][spoiler]Petalportals[/spoiler] now have an effect to show they're slowly dying.
[*]The game now uses borderless fullscreen.
[*]Added the option to swap confirm & back's controls for those on controllers who would enjoy this.
[*]Achievements now should attempt to unlock every time you enter an area. This does not include the achievement for [spoiler]blowing up the nuke in the mafia base, although you can trigger that achievement again by simply doing it again. (Make sure you aren't using God Mode!)[/spoiler]
[*]Added a popup for when you collect all the tax documents telling you what to do next.
[*]Added the quickswap buttons to the collection screen UI.
[*]Added a community menu on the main menu with information as to how to join our [url=https://snoozykazoo.com/discord]Discord[/url]!
[*]Improved the keyblock disappear particle effect.
[*]Made the read screen for documents easier to read by removing text effects. (v1.0.2)
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the shaking audio the wardrobe makes in the [spoiler]Bomb Bunker[/spoiler] wouldn't stop playing when Turnip Boy leaves the room.
[*]Fixed a bug that would prevent Movemelons from properly allowing Turnip Boy to push them if they were grown before Turnip Boy got the Move Mittens.
[*]Fixed the softlock players were encountering in the southern area of the Forgotten Forest.
[*]Fixed an issue where [spoiler]Liz's scream audio[/spoiler] would play multiple times at once.
[*]Fixed a typo on the directions sign in the Plain Plains.
[*]Fixed the it's used in the [spoiler]Rotten Cat Apple's[/spoiler] boss description.
[*]Fixed an issue where touching an enemy even while in the hit-stunned state would shake the screen instead of just being on hit.
[*]Slightly moved the sign in the northern Forgotten Forest to cover less of the puzzle.
[*]Fixed a bug with time stopping not being registered when paused, which broke the on screen button prompts.
[*]Improved the look of the document popup when it first appears.
[*]The game will now properly deal with tampered save files. ([b]WARNING[/b]: do not manually edit your save file, as now the game will delete it to prevent several crashes.)
[*][spoiler]Humans will now no longer appear in the Bomb Bunker if they already have attempted to flee, regardless of if the player leaves the area before they fully flee.[/spoiler]
[*]Option selectors should now properly use the correct fonts when swapping languages. (v1.0.2)
[/list]

We hope this update resolves some common issues, and we hope your turnip experience is [b]fun as heck[/b]! :)
